Name: Wildgoats’ Rocks
Description: The Rocks of the Wild Goats were the crags near En-gedi where David hid from Saul, and where Saul went to seek him, entering the cave in which David cut off the skirt of his robe.
BiblicalSignificance: The rocks are David's hiding place in the En-gedi wilderness: the crags above the cave where he spared Saul.
